prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Letter Finds Zoe; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Illustrative ordinary postal route from Kit’s home through a sorting center to Zoe’s home. No named postal operator, flags, logos or exact delivery-time claim. Addresses face away or appear as ruled lines, not fabricated readable personal data.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One cream envelope with a small green star postage stamp at upper right; One folded picture of a red toy truck inside; One blue collection box; Gray mail trays and one plain delivery van; Zoe’s blue front door with a mail slot; Collection worker: tan skin, short brown hair, navy shirt and gray trousers; Carrier: brown skin, short black hair, pale blue shirt and navy trousers
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Only one letter; small green star postage stamp is already fixed on the envelope’s front.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Over Kit’s shoulder, show the cream envelope on the table with the red-truck picture partly tucked inside. His writing hand partly occludes the envelope front as he adds the address; the near edge is outside the frame, so no invented address lettering is visible. Continuity: One letter; green star postage stamp already fixed at upper right.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.

visualReview.scope: Direct native and installed reference-board inspection
visualReview.notes: Cast and distinct adult roles, cream green-star envelope, red truck picture, blue mailbox/door, gray trays and plain van inspected. Board variants are design references, not current scene inventory.
